VIDEO ID: HUY-DRILL-001

TITLE:
The Drill Works Perfectly Until It Touches Wood

MAIN CHARACTER:
CHAR-01 — HUY

DURATION:
45 seconds

FORMAT:
Vertical 9:16

STYLE:
Photorealistic technical repair short film.

SCENE 1 — THE MYSTERY (0–4 seconds)
CLIP: c1.mp4

Huy holds a cordless drill in a realistic Vietnamese workshop. He activates the drill without a load. The motor spins normally.

Camera: Close-up of the rotating chuck, followed by a close-up of Huy's face.

SCENE 2 — INITIAL INVESTIGATION (4–10 seconds)
CLIP: c2.mp4 0:01-0:07

Huy removes the battery after switching off the drill.

Camera: Over-the-shoulder shot and macro shots of the battery connection.

SCENE 3 — DIAGNOSTIC TEST (10–19 seconds)
CLIP: c3a.mp4 0:00-0:04, c3b.mp4 0:00-0:05
VOICE: Huy đo điện áp pin khi có tải.
ON SCREEN: Voltage drops under load

Huy uses appropriate diagnostic equipment to evaluate battery voltage under a controlled load.

Camera: Close-up of the test setup and measuring instrument.

SCENE 4 — VERIFIED REPAIR (19–31 seconds)
CLIP: c4.mp4

After confirming that the battery pack is faulty, Huy replaces it with a compatible, verified battery pack.

SCENE 5 — FINAL TEST (31–41 seconds)
CLIP: c5a.mp4, c5b.mp4

Huy performs a controlled drilling test using suitable wood and a securely supported workpiece.

SCENE 6 — ENDING (41–45 seconds)
CLIP: c6.mp4 0:00-0:03

Huy switches off the drill, removes the battery, and looks toward the camera with a slight smile.

Optional Vietnamese dialogue:

"Máy không yếu. Nguồn điện mới là vấn đề."

End card:
ONE SYMPTOM. MULTIPLE POSSIBLE CAUSES.

IMPORTANT TECHNICAL RULE:
The faulty battery is the confirmed cause in this episode. Do not imply that every drill stopping under load has a faulty battery.
